subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are delighted to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Your seat assignment is 15A, and the flight departure time is at 10:00 AM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least two hours before departure for smooth check-in. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Airlines Team
